_about: Scenarios (1.0, docs/POLISH.md), started from the title screen by scripts/main.gd start_scenario. settings: the land (seed, size, continents, water 0..1, climate -0.3..0.3). peoples and per_village: who founds the world. age: the age (index in data/ages.json) every kingdom starts in. era: the mood of the world at the start. war: the first two kingdoms are at war. laws: switched on or off. years: how long the world runs before the player takes it.

scenarios.name: The Twin Isles
scenarios.text: Two peoples on two islands across a narrow sea. Who will cross first?

scenarios.name: Age of Steam
scenarios.text: Three kingdoms wake in the Industrial Age. Smoke rises; the world will warm.

scenarios.name: The Brink
scenarios.text: Two atomic powers at war. Will anyone drop the bomb?

scenarios.name: The Long Night
scenarios.text: A dark era falls on a young world: monsters breed, plagues spread.

scenarios.name: Ice Age
scenarios.text: Snow covers the world and the cold will not leave. Can anyone thrive?

scenarios.name: Golden Age
scenarios.text: Every people at once, in a bright era: a crowded, hopeful world.

scenarios.name: The Quiet Earth
scenarios.text: No disasters, no plagues, no spirits: only the peoples and their choices.
